name: googleworkspace-mcp
description: Remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers exposing Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Tasks) write/automation via direct REST, with Google OAuth.
author: Ian McDonald

scripts.dev: npm run gen-config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run gen-config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
